Name: Low Health Warning
Author: Newva
Description:
Tired of dying because you didn't notice your health was low? I was, too. Low Health Warning provides messages, sounds, and a screen flash when your heatlh is low.

[b]Configuration via config.json
[/b]Change the values of the settings to your liking. 
Sounds can be anything in the game. (https://gist.github.com/dpchamps/46b1473415d412e220a21cb84dd9aad6 has a list of many, if not all available sounds). Caution choosing a longer sound as they will overlap and play for a long time. 
Leave sounds or messages blank to disable the function.
Alert Locations: The default is to alert only in the Mines, Skull Cavern, and Volcano Dungeon. (UndergroundMine is the game name for both the mines and skull cavern).

If you know the location names of other places you want to be alerted, you can add them to the list.     
[code]"AlertLocations": [
"UndergroundMine",
"VolcanoDungeon",
    "NewLocationName"
  ]
[/code]

If you want the alert in all locations, empty the list.  
[code]"AlertLocations": []
[/code]
